ticker_news.title: Where Will Alphabet Stock Be in 1 Year?
ticker_news.description: Alphabet is seeing strong demand for its AI-powered products, which is providing a new growth driver. However, ongoing tech sector regulatory scrutiny adds a layer of uncertainty for investors to balance in 2025. Despite these challenges, Alphabet's diversified ecosystem and leadership in AI position the company well for sustained profitable growth.
ticker_news.author: Dan Victor
